title: Anar Sarbat
description: Anar Sarbat (Pomegranate Syrup) is a highly refreshing and delicious syrup made from the sweet and sour juice of ripe pomegranates. This classical formulation strengthens the stomach. Improves appetite. Reduces burning sensations. Boosts hemoglobin levels.
dosage: 25–40 ml mixed in a glass of chilled water, taken during the day
